text: What brings you here, young lamb?
zh: 是什么风把你吹来的，年轻的羔羊？

text: Do you seek guidance by our Mages?
zh: 你是来寻求我们法师的指引？

text: Or is it our wine you desire?
zh: 还是渴望我们的葡萄酒？

text: There you are, young lamb.
zh: 你来了，年轻的羔羊。

text: Did you call me lamb?
zh: 你刚才叫我羔羊？

text: What are you doing here?
zh: 你在这里做什么？

text: You mentioned wine.
zh: 你提到了葡萄酒。

text: Open the gate.
zh: 开门吧。

text: What do you know about the stolen Arcanum Sanguis?
zh: 关于被盗的血之秘典，你知道些什么？

text: See you!
zh: 回见！

text: Below the saving hands of our father we all are lambs.
zh: 在我们的父神施予救赎的双手之下，我们皆是羔羊。

text: It does not matter who you are in the eyes of our father.
zh: 在我们的父神眼中，你是何人并无分别。

text: Our father?
zh: 我们的父神？

text: I've heard enough.
zh: 我听够了。

text:
Yes!
Our father who created the earth, the fire, the sea, the rivers, the wind and every living creature.
zh:
正是！
我们的父神创造了大地、火焰、海洋、河流、风，以及一切生灵。

text: It is our father who grants us the strength and will to participate as a part of this world.
zh: 是我们的父神赐予我们力量与意志，让我们得以作为这世界的一部分而存在。

text: It is he who we serve and it is he who enables us to use greater powers such as magic.
zh: 我们侍奉的是他，而正是他让我们能够运用魔法这般伟大的力量。

text: I am the guardian of the academy gate.
zh: 我是学院大门的守卫。

text: My task is to decide whether one is granted access or has to leave.
zh: 我的职责是判定来者可以入内，还是必须离开。

text: Haven't you heard about our wine?
zh: 你没听说过我们的葡萄酒吗？

text: It is a good which is often consumed and highly requested in Grenmark, as well as other regions and lands.
zh: 无论在格伦马克，还是在其他地区与国度，它都是广受欢迎、供不应求的佳品。

text: I see you have no evil intentions, so you are granted entry.
zh: 我看得出你并无恶意，准你入内。

text: May our father guide your way.
zh: 愿我们的父神指引你的道路。

text: Young lamb, why do you ask about such a dangerous book?
zh: 年轻的羔羊，你为何要打听这样一本危险的书？

text: Though, it is true that the book was stolen just recently.
zh: 不过，那本书确实是前不久被盗的。

text: You may want to talk to the mages inside the academy about that, as I am just a mere keeper of the gate.
zh: 这件事你最好去问学院里的法师们，我只不过是个看门人罢了。
